label: Travellers using generative AI to plan travel
question: How fast is generative AI adoption growing in travel planning?
answer: 18% of global travellers used generative AI for travel planning in 2025, up from 11% the year before (a 64% increase).
methodology: Amadeus global traveller survey reported in Travel Trends 2026. Repeated question wording across 2024 and 2025 waves, which makes the year-on-year change more reliable than either level on its own.
